capabilities: generate a chronological timeline from tagged notes
select events by a tag or a set of tags
link each timeline entry to its source note
extras: Full documentation lives outside the README at a separate docs site; a video tutorial exists for first-time users, and the README warns that the last major update included breaking changes.
intentEvidence: See the changelog from the last major update to view any breaking changes here.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize notes with dates as a chronological timeline.
summary: Timeline generator that renders notes carrying a specific tag or tag set as chronological events.
